entities.name: Pathologist
entities.rationale: White outlined icon of a doctor/pathologist at top left of the board. Standalone actor, not inside any container. Pathologists annotate/label images and validate models on the Kubernetes platform.

entities.name: Hospital
entities.rationale: White outlined hospital building icon at top right of the board. Standalone actor, not inside any container. Hospitals/biologists/clients send medical images to S3 and consume inference.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Orange Kubernetes icon labelled 'EKS' at center top (AWS_Icon_6). Standalone, no container. Hosts the labelling product for pathologists and the inference serving.

entities.name: S3 (raw images)
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labelled 'S3' on the left (AWS_Icon_4), annotated '5TB'. Standalone, no container. Stores medical images sent by hospitals, about 5 TB per project.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: Teal icon labelled 'SAGEMAKER' in the center (AWS_Icon_5). Standalone, no container. Trains one model per project using enriched data with Docker containers.

entities.name: S3 (models)
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labelled 'S3' on the right (AWS_Icon_3). Standalone, no container. Stores trained models and results output by SageMaker.

entities.name: FSx
entities.rationale: Green icon labelled 'FSx' at bottom left (AWS_Icon_2). Standalone, no container. Used with SageMaker training for I/O performance.

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: Red icon labelled 'IAM' at bottom right (AWS_Icon_1). Standalone, no container. Used with SageMaker for security and data access control/compliance.

visual_connections.description: Long curved green arrow from the hospital icon sweeping down to the left S3 bucket (5TB): hospitals send medical images into S3.
Short line from the pathologist icon down to the EKS icon: pathologists use the Kubernetes platform to annotate images and validate models.
Curved arrow from the left S3 bucket up to EKS: images are loaded into the Kubernetes product to show to pathologists.
Curved arrow from EKS down to SageMaker: enriched/annotated data is used to train a model per project.
Arrow from SageMaker to the right S3 bucket: trained model is stored in an S3 bucket.
Curved arrow from the right S3 bucket up to EKS: model and results are exported to the Kubernetes product for validation and inference.
Plain line between SageMaker and FSx: SageMaker training uses FSx for I/O performance.
Plain line between SageMaker and IAM: SageMaker training uses IAM for security and data access control.
